Football betting explained

Published 2026-02-01

Main markets

The most popular football bets are the match result, over/under goals and both teams to score. Handicaps level the field between favourites and underdogs, and accumulators combine several selections for bigger but riskier payouts.

How odds work

Decimal odds show your total return per unit staked: odds of 3.00 turn a 10 EUR stake into 30 EUR. The bookmaker builds a margin into every market, so the implied probabilities always add up to more than one hundred percent.

Basic tips

Set a budget, stick to markets you understand, and compare odds between bookmakers before placing a bet. Team news an hour before kick-off moves lines more than any statistic.
